body:
we named the whole thing after this song.

"long live" is the closest taylor's ever come to writing a thank-you note in a track. she's called it "the first love song that i've written to my team" -- not to a person, to the band and crew who built her career brick by brick. it started backstage on the last night of the fearless tour in 2010, and it never really left: it closed the speak now world tour, came back on the red tour and the 1989 world tour, showed up as a reputation-era piano mashup, and turned up again on the eras tour.

rolling stone called it the album's peak -- "a ridiculously over-the-top prom anthem" from someone who chose to spend her actual high school years on a tour bus. "damn if you don't believe every word."

we did. that's the name.

longlivets.com
